name: Harrier

62310.name: Harrier Drive - DMG UP
62310.SpecificEffects:
ST Movement <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
ST movement type changes to Levitating, enabling it to pass over low obstacles.
When in combat, enemy DMG Taken <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.

RelatedDescription: An upgraded version of the legacy Jet Amplifier. This jetpack enables an ST to fly over short distances, quickly traversing obstacles to reach even the most inaccessible corners of the battlefield. It can also inflict a DMG Taken UP effect on the enemy.
